title: With the pointer over a scrollable view, scrolling visually updates the highlighted item only after the complete animated scroll effect is finished
line: Scrolling Kickoff's app lists now keeps highlighting the item under the pointer instead of a stale one.
explanation: Kickoff's item delegates turned hover off for 200 ms after every wheel event (added in 5368861d87 so scrolling over the category sidebar wouldn't switch categories). That block applied to every list, so while scrolling the app list the highlight stayed on the item that scrolled away and only caught up once the wheel events stopped. The change keeps the block only for category sidebar items, so app and search lists follow the item under the pointer as the content moves.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: keep hover highlight following the pointer when scrolling

Hover was ignored for 200 ms after every wheel event so that scrolling
over the sidebar wouldn't switch categories, but this also left app
lists highlighting a stale item while scrolling. Only block categories.

BUG: 509188

patches.diff:
From 1d3dc4a18ed0573b7e46d6188fec716aac386aef Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:31:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: keep hover highlight following the pointer
 when scrolling

Hover was ignored for 200 ms after every wheel event so that scrolling
over the sidebar wouldn't switch categories, but this also left app
lists highlighting a stale item while scrolling. Only block categories.

BUG: 509188
---
 applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml b/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
index bc4fcbae6c..58215d55c4 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
@@ -199,7 +199,8 @@ T.ItemDelegate {
         hoverEnabled: root.view
             // When the movedWithWheel condition is broken, this ensures that
             // onEntered is called again without moving the mouse.
-            && !root.view.movedWithWheel
+            // Only categories need this, so scrolling doesn't switch them.
+            && !(root.isCategoryListItem && root.view.movedWithWheel)
             // Fix VerticalStackView animation causing view currentIndex
             // to change while delegates are moving under the mouse cursor
             && kickoff.fullRepresentationItem && !kickoff.fullRepresentationItem.contentItem.busy && !kickoff.fullRepresentationItem.blockingHoverFocus
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Mid-scroll on master: the pointer is on Claude but the highlight is still on Catfish, which scrolled away.
Same moment with the fix: the item under the pointer (Claude) is highlighted.
Six wheel notches over All Applications on master: the highlight lags behind the pointer.
Same scroll with the fix: the highlight follows the item under the pointer.

review.text: Minimal, well-scoped fix in `AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml` that restricts the 200 ms `movedWithWheel` hover suppression to category sidebar items (`root.isCategoryListItem`), where it is needed to avoid accidental category switching while scrolling. App and search lists/grids now keep hover highlighting aligned with the pointer during wheel scrolling (and in non-scrollable views), while preserving sidebar and keyboard-navigation behavior. Before/after screenshots and videos clearly prove the fix.

reviews.text: Minimal, well-scoped fix in `AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml` that restricts the 200 ms `movedWithWheel` hover suppression to category sidebar items (`root.isCategoryListItem`), where it is needed to avoid accidental category switching while scrolling. App and search lists/grids now keep hover highlighting aligned with the pointer during wheel scrolling (and in non-scrollable views), while preserving sidebar and keyboard-navigation behavior. Before/after screenshots and videos clearly prove the fix.

The diagnosis is right: the 200 ms movedWithWheel hover block in AbstractKickoffItemDelegate makes app and search lists keep a stale highlight. Lifting the block there is clean, and the before/after media prove that part. But the reporter's c2 attachment (Video_2026-10-21, last ~7 s) shows the other half of the report: wheeling over the non-scrollable category sidebar (Internet, Sistema) makes the hover highlight under the pointer blink off and on. That happens because hoverEnabled goes false there, and this patch deliberately keeps the block for categories. With the default switchCategoryOnHover off, onEntered already returns early for categories, so in that case the block only hides the hover highlight and protects nothing, so the bug as reported (c2: 'even with elements in areas that are capable of being scrollable but currently aren't') stays open.
changes: Keep the category hover highlight while wheeling: only apply the movedWithWheel block to category items when Plasmoid.configuration.switchCategoryOnHover is on (and ideally, even then, keep hover visuals and skip only the currentIndex change in onEntered), so the sidebar highlight no longer blinks

Verify by wheeling over the category sidebar with the pointer on a category (default settings and with switchCategoryOnHover on): the highlight stays on the hovered category and the category does not switch; add before/after media of that case and update commit message/line to cover the sidebar
